'''March 2001 Fitchburg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fitchburg, Massachusetts on 11 March 2001. [[Andy Klema]] won it. It is known from Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1882">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-the-rattler-gets-rock-bottomedd1882/ the-rattler-gets-rock-bottomed], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 12 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-the-rattler-gets-rock-bottomedd1882/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Fitchburg, Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Klema]]

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Michael Schiemer The Rattler Gets Rock Bottomed (tournament report)]] — by [[Michael Schiemer]], 8th or 9th, 4–2

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Michael Schiemer's report calls it a Saturday tournament; Mike Gemme's report (titled '3-11', 'last sunday') and Andy Klema's ('Sundays tourney in Fitchburg') put it on Sunday 11 March 2001.<ref name="tr-d1882" />
* Attendance is given as 'only about 25 people' by Michael Schiemer and 'something like 30 in the end' by Andy Klema.<ref name="tr-d1882" />
